name: caustics-background

frames.best_why: Shows the headline, copy and buttons over a full, evenly lit caustic web with no cursor.

tagline: Headline floating over a rippling pool of light that stirs at the cursor.
summary: A full-width hero backdrop painting moving pool-floor caustics, with a headline and buttons above. Moving the cursor or clicking sends ripples through the light.
appearance: A deep teal field is covered by a bright, animated web of caustic lines. Centred white headline text, a small paragraph and two pill links sit above the water, softly shadowed.
behaviour: The caustic web drifts continuously, and the cursor leaves wakes of small rings while a click drops a larger ripple that bends the light. The headline's shadow sways with the same water.
demo_content: Headline Swim before work, copy about 40 city pools, a Book a lane button and Find a pool link.
use_when: A full-screen hero wants an atmospheric, interactive water surface behind its message.
avoid_when: It runs a WebGL shader every frame, and low-power devices pay for the continuous motion.
customise: Set the headline via title, pass custom content as children and toggle pointer interaction; the shader colours and water look need source edits.
weight_why: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader redraws every frame while visible.

a11y.note: The canvas is aria-hidden and reduced-motion freezes the water; ripples are pointer-only.

issues: Small paragraph is faint over the bright caustic lines and hard to read.
polish_why: Striking, well-crafted water shader with a readable headline and a real interaction.
title: Caustics Background
